entities.summary: Milan "Minja" Subota was a Serbian-Yugoslavian composer, musician, entertainer and photographer, born in Sarajevo. He was the host of the long-running children's TV show Muzički tobogan on RTS. In 2021, he was awarded the Order of Karađorđe's Star.
